scope: Finite Discrete Causal DAG and Identifiable Back-Door Adjustment Scope
equations: No Z descendant of X in original DAG; X and Y d-separated by Z after removal of OUTGOING X edges
Positive P(z) requires positive P(x,z) for every treatment level; zero-mass strata skipped explicitly
Observational P(Y=y|X=x) and first-versus-last treatment-level risk differences are distinct outputs
All-observed graph compatibility: P(v)=product_i P(v_i|parents_i) for every complete assignment,including zero cells
contract: Strict exact fields and pinned profile/catalog hashes. schema_version/profile.version exact integer1. Opaque IDs ASCII1..64. Nodes2..8,unique ids; states2..3 unique IDs sorted lexicographically for canonical risk/contrast order; observed exactbool. Edges distinct directed pairs,known endpoints,no self-edge,no cycle.

Treatment/outcome distinct observed nodes; outcome_value declared state. Adjustment distinct known observed nodes,excluding treatment/outcome. Descendants of treatment yield accepted unsupported_adjustment diagnostic,not an estimate. Latent nodes yield unsupported_latent_graph; no latent identification certified.

joint explicitly contains exactly one row for EVERY assignment of OBSERVED nodes,including zero weights; row.assignment exact observed keys anddeclared states. Complete observed Cartesian product<=4096. Weights exact nonnegative rationals,total exactly1; no implicit missing cells,duplicates or normalization/smoothing.

Input rationals integer (notbool) or signed integer/positive-denominator strings,each component<=18digits. No float,decimal,exponent,leadingzero,-zero or zero denominator. Output reduced Fraction strings. Guard each addition,multiplication anddivision by conservative8192-bit numerator/denominator reservations before the operation.

Assumptions exactbooleans causal_graph=true,consistency=true,exchangeability_under_graph=true,selection_bias=false are declared,not inferred from data. No causal learning,source truth or real-world adequacy certification.

Production d-separation uses a bounded active-trail direction-state traversal with ancestors of conditioning set. Independently verify through complete simple-path collider/noncollider enumeration before engine. Original sufficient criterion only,not generalized adjustment or general do-calculus.

All-observed exact factorization compatibility checked for every complete joint assignment. Conditional factor with zero parent marginal yields product0 for that assignment; any positive full-row cannot have zero parent marginal. Latent graphs report compatibility not_checked. Compatibility is necessary mathematical consistency,not proof of causal truth or faithfulness.

Diagnostic priority: unsupported_latent_graph,unsupported_adjustment,incompatible_joint_graph,not_estimable_positivity,identified_under_declared_assumptions. Each failed gate leaves interventional=null. Observational conditionals may still be reported; zero treatment mass gives null observational probability.

For valid compatible graphs, aggregate marginal P(z) and joint P(x,z),P(y,x,z). All positive P(z) require overlap for ALL declared X levels. Zero P(z) strata listed and skipped; any missing positive-mass overlap prevents ALL interventional estimates. Report exact per-stratum terms,each risk and first-minus-last contrast named explicitly.

Canonical nodes,edges,adjustment,row assignments and state labels. Model hash binds graph,assumptions and query; table hash binds sorted rows. Input/report hashes retain exact original input order. Inputs not mutated.

Synthetic provenance true,self_authored rights,source_ref in frozen catalog,nonempty attribution/snapshot<=4000characters and exact UTF8 snapshot SHA. No real dataset ingestion; declarations/hashes are not independent rights or causal validation.

Preflight complete cells<=4096,nodes<=8,states<=3,edges<=28;work reservation joint_cells*nodes*nodes*8<=5000000;returned_cells=joint_cells*nodes+strata*treatment_states*8<=100000. No exponential simple-path production search; individual maxima cannot combine freely. Actual CPU/memory measurements required before closure.

supported: Exact standardized and observational probabilities with overlap diagnostics
experimental_research_only: Interpreting synthetic risks as empirical causal forecasts

P1: Lawful full-book/latest-revision source access and edition-specific equation verification
Empirical dataset-specific provenance,consent,causal assumptions,selection/measurement and sensitivity review
Latent-variable identification and separately verified front-door/IV extensions
P2: Structural-equation language and individual counterfactual uplift

runtime: Python standard library offline CPU; no DoWhy/NetworkX installation or code copying
